## Problem

A clear description of the problem this feature would solve, or the gap it fills.

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. Be as specific as possible.

## Component

- [ ] Smart contract — new instruction or account
- [ ] Backend API — new endpoint or middleware
- [ ] Frontend — new UI or flow
- [ ] Developer tooling / tests
- [ ] Documentation

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Any relevant context, links, or prior art.
